Vertical integration into downstream processing—TPIA's petrochemicals, PKPK's plantation-to-energy—is the key margin moat as commodity price swings widen.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesia renewables names on domestic demand strength: TOBA (+7.55%) and TPIA (+3.31%) lead as local policy tailwinds and captive industrial offtake outpace US volatility. Favor TOBA for near-term momentum, but rotate into TPIA for structural chemical-energy integration. Trim US-exposed PLUG and ARKO; hold cash for pullbacks in LAPD and PKPK on any IDX correction.

Rotate into food-service and specialty retail sub-sectors with earnings momentum, avoid broad index exposure. Target 3-6 week horizon, set tight stops at 5% below entry given normal signal volatility.
